changelog: **Admin-defined forms — schema and write boundary (#1800):** `FormDefinition` (per-org `key` + `version`, audience, surface, publish/archive), `FormField` (key, type, trilingual labels/help/options, `required`, `matchable`) and `FormResponse` (answers keyed by `fieldKey`, `@@index([orgId, fieldKey])` for matching). `FormDefinition` and `FormResponse` are in `TENANT_MODELS`; `FormField` is reached through its definition. The rules live in `src/lib/forms/definitionRule.ts` (pure) and `src/lib/forms/definitions.ts` (the one writer): a published version is never edited in place — the edit is version N+1; a published key's type is fixed (409 `field_type_locked`), an existing field cannot be re-keyed (409 `field_key_locked`); a free-text field can never be `matchable` (400); publishing archives the older version; answers resolve across versions (`latestFormAnswers()`), archived fields included. Admin API: `/api/admin/forms`, `/api/admin/forms/[id]`, `/api/admin/forms/[id]/publish`. Answers validate through the shared `validateResponse()`. Design: `docs/forms.md`.
